note: sha256Finalize on a real @bsv/sdk Spend. No signature: the witness is (state, remaining, msgBitLen). Honest digest: sha256Finalize(IV, 'abc', 24) = node SHA-256('abc'). F-114: the compiled sha256Finalize aborts unless the state is 32 bytes; remaining stays variable-length (0..119, past which the negative OP_NUM2BIN pad aborts). GK-BUG-013: msgBitLen must lie in [0, 2^64); the 9th byte of its 9-byte OP_NUM2BIN form is checked to be 0x00 instead of dropped. The interpreter verdict is asserted equal to the Spend verdict on every row.
